verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Thoropass MCP server, which exposes Thoropass data and actions to an external AI assistant. That is the server role and does not show Thoropass consuming third-party MCP servers. Nothing shows the AI Helpbot or First Pass AI connecting to external MCP servers, so this applicable client-side capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
